body_markdown:
*Punta Gorda Homebuyers are Invited to New Amenity Showcase Event*


PUNTA GORDA, Fla.


, Sept. 11, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Lennar, one of the nation's leading homebuilders, today announced the opening of the new amenities at Tuckers Cove at Babcock Ranch, bringing waterpark-inspired activities to the growing Punta Gorda master-planned community. The new attractions feature a lazy river, water slide experience, and on-site dining at the Shipwreck Tavern, expanding the resort-style offerings residents of Tuckers Cove at Babcock Ranch already enjoy.


Interested homebuyers are invited to the Tuckers Cove Pirate Adventure Amenity Showcase event on Saturday, September 19 from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. to explore the new amenities, tour model homes and experience the Tuckers Cove lifestyle firsthand. The celebration will feature photo opportunities with live pirates, a pirate-themed scavenger hunt, kid-friendly activities, free refreshments, and the opportunity to win prizes. Interested guests are encouraged to RSVP[here](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4771947-1&h=389895638&u=https%3A%2F%2Flennar.com%2Fnew-homes%2Fflorida%2Fnaples-ft-myers%2Fevent%2Fthecovegrandopeningevent%3Futm_source%3Dchatgpt.com&a=here) .


"X marks the spot at Tuckers Cove," said Jeff Dew, Director of Sales for Lennar at Babcock Ranch. "With the opening of these amenities, our residents can make the most of life in Southwest Florida. We're excited to invite the public to come tour the community for themselves through our Pirate Adventure Amenity Showcase and see what makes Tuckers Cove such a unique place to call home."


Tuckers Cove at Babcock Ranch offers a variety of new homes across many exclusive Lennar collections, offering a range of floorplans. Homes range from 1,417 to 3,945 square feet with two to six bedrooms and two to four bathrooms. Tuckers Cove at Babcock Ranch offers select plans available with a Next Gen® suite, Lennar's home-within-a-home design that provides private living space with its own entrance to accommodate multigenerational families under one roof. Pricing ranges from the $200,000s to the $700,000s.


The newly opened amenities enhance the exclusive lifestyle Tuckers Cove at Babcock Ranch residents currently enjoy. From aquatic parks to Luau Beach, the private lakeside oasis, the community boasts an amenity-rich lifestyle with splash pads, sparkling pools, various sport courts, a fitness center, a dog park, and curated community events that blend new home living, outdoor recreation, and resort-style activities.


For more information on homes available at Tuckers Cove at Babcock Ranch, call (844) 280-3912 or visit[the community website](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4771947-1&h=354894445&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lennar.com%2Fnew-homes%2Fflorida%2Fnaples-ft-myers%2Fpunta-gorda%2Ftuckers-cove-at-babcock-ranch&a=the+community+website) .
